name: Comet Encke (2P/Encke)
description: Short-period comet (3.3-year orbit) on its best return for northern observers since 2003. Predicted to brighten rapidly through January to about magnitude 5-7 (binoculars) in Aquarius, low in the evening twilight. Perihelion is on 10 February 2027, by which time it is lost in the Sun's glare. Comet brightness predictions are uncertain.
